# Provena Copilot entry point

Read and follow [the root AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) before changing this repository. It is the authoritative project rule set and context router. Select only the documentation and procedures relevant to the task; do not load every document. Verify the current implementation before editing. Report unavailable checks honestly.
